name: Table 1-15: Territory Traits
_doc: Per-terrain sub-tables. Roll 1d5-1 (minimum 1) times on the appropriate section based on the Territory's Base Terrain. Each result is a trait that modifies the Territory's effects.

forests.name: Roll again twice and apply both

mountain_ranges.name: Roll again twice and apply both

plains.name: Roll again twice and apply both

swamps.name: Roll again twice and apply both

wastelands.name: Roll again twice and apply both

trait_descriptions.fertile: The soil is especially fecund. Unique strains may pop up; can serve as agricultural outpost.
trait_descriptions.foothills: A single towering peak qualifies as a Mountain Landmark; supersedes (does not stack with) normal Mountain Range navigate bonuses.
trait_descriptions.notable_species: One of the Planet's more noteworthy native species is found only in this Territory. Generate a new species or a dramatic local variation. May source an Organic Compound Resource (GM discretion).
trait_descriptions.ruined: Land wounded by outside forces (orbital strike, war, daemonic incursion). Fear Test to enter (difficulty by cataclysm). Within: +1 additional Corruption Point per Corruption gained.
trait_descriptions.stagnant: Little life or activity. Travel times doubled; Navigation (Surface) Tests at -10.
trait_descriptions.unique_compound: Local flora contains a substance of great value. The Planet gains an additional Organic Compound Resource — nature and Abundance generated normally.
trait_descriptions.unusual_location: The Territory exists where local conditions would not normally create the Base Terrain (e.g., Forest in polar region, Wasteland surrounded by verdant fields). Possibly +10 to resist the Planet's typical extreme-temperature influence in the affected area.
trait_descriptions.virulent: Marshy plague-cauldrons. Day spent here = Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or Wound (ignores TB & Armour). Drinking untreated water = Toxic Damage / fevers / Insanity. All Rending Damage here treated as Toxic. Medicae Tests at -20.
